Train and test split: Ten-fold CV at the subject level
Leakage risk: Low; SMOTE applied to training folds only

Train and test split: None; posterior estimation on the full sample
Leakage risk: Not applicable; no predictive hold-out
Missing data: Five-year ACS estimates used to reduce county-level missingness

Train and test split: Random split of 424 scans into 272, 68 and 84

Train and test split: Subjects split into training and test, evaluated at landmark times

External validation: A second cohort (NACC), with the model refitted there
